extends.rule: Portfolios P1 and P2 are cp1_golden/1.1's P1 and P2: the same ids, accounts, events, ledger_seq and atomic_group values, read from methodology/fixtures/cp1_golden/cp1_golden_fixture.json. This file adds market data and CP3 assertions for them. P3 to P6 are new and fully defined here.

format.inherits: Every rule in cp1_golden/1.1 'format' applies: numbers are JSON strings parsed with decimal.Decimal(str) and never as float; money objects are {amount, currency}; dates are ISO dates; ids are fixed UUIDs; events use domain.ledger.LedgerEvent field names; atomic_group is a loader instruction; 'detail': null means NOT ASSERTED; 'value' is null iff state is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
format.value: The PRESENTED value (performance/1.1 Ruling 2.2): money in the metric's currency, ROUND_HALF_UP to the minor unit (USD, HKD, CNY: 2 decimals); returns, shares and ratios as decimal fractions, ROUND_HALF_UP to 12 decimals. Compare by Decimal numeric equality.
format.exact: The engine-tier exact value (Ruling 2.1) as a reduced fraction string 'p/q', or an integer string. Compare with Fraction(p, q) equality against ComputedMetric.exact. null when the state is INSUFFICIENT_DATA, and null for an irrational result (then 'tolerance' is given).
format.tolerance: Absent or '0': exact equality of the presented value (and of 'exact' where given). A decimal string (e.g. '1e-10'): |engine presented value - expected presented value| <= tolerance (Ruling 11.2, transcendental outputs).

kinds.portfolio_value: Total value. 'view': 'REPORTING' (in the portfolio's reporting currency) or 'NATIVE' with 'currency' (the per-currency native subtotal of Ruling 1.4: cash in that currency plus positions whose listing currency it is).
kinds.holding_value: Value of one (account_id, listing_id) position. 'view' REPORTING or NATIVE (NATIVE = the listing's trading currency). Optional freshness fields: price_date_used (the session whose close was used), missed_sessions (int), fx_fixing_date (REPORTING view, when a rate is used).
kinds.cash_value: Value of one (account_id, currency) cash balance, 'view' REPORTING or NATIVE.
kinds.priced_holdings_value: Ruling 1.4a. When 'emitted' is false the metric must not be emitted at all for that date. When emitted: state/value/exact as usual plus 'excluded_count' and 'excluded' (list of {component: 'position'|'cash', account_id, listing_id|currency, native, reason}); the list is compared as a set.
kinds.gain_absolute: G over the window (Ruling 5.1), money in the reporting currency.
kinds.annualized_twr: Ruling 7.2 with 'year_fraction' (Ruling 7.1) asserted as an exact fraction string.

format.engine_metric_ids: Kinds map to the CP3a engine's metric ids (tech plan §16.14, as read 2026-10-01): portfolio_value -> portfolio_value; holding_value -> holding_value; cash_value -> cash_value; priced_holdings_value -> portfolio_value_priced_holdings, whose excluded_count is the number of excluded COMPONENTS (positions, cash and receivables; the engine's lineage 'excluded_components'), not 'excluded_holdings'; gain_absolute, twr, annualized_twr -> the engine's ids for Rulings 5.1 and 7.2. A rename on either side is a mapping change in the loader, not a fixture change.
format.window: Every window-based assertion carries 'window': {request, base, end, days}. 'request' is what the caller asks: {rule: 'SINCE_INCEPTION'} or {rule: 'TRAILING_MONTHS', months: n} or {rule: 'CUSTOM', base: date}, always with the assertion's 'as_of' as end. 'base' (B) and 'days' (E - B) are the expected window actually used (Ruling 5.4: end-of-month rule; base must be >= inception). For a refused window, base and days are still asserted as computed; the refusal is in state/reason/detail.
format.lineage_includes: Optional list of lineage cause names that the result's causes must include (the result may carry others). Used where a cause has no state effect (ZERO_CAPITAL_RUN).
format.detail_names: Detail and lineage names are those of performance/1.1 §16 item 17 (NON_POSITIVE_BASE, WINDOW_BEFORE_INCEPTION, PERIOD_SHORTER_THAN_ONE_YEAR, ZERO_CAPITAL_RUN, ...). Where a cause is a CP2 lineage cause (staleness, no history, synthetic, single source) the detail is null (not asserted); state and reason carry the meaning.
format.synthetic: Every result computed against this fixture's market data must be marked synthetic (market-data Ruling 4.8). Asserted once, in structural_assertions S-1.

market_data.how_to_load: The loader EXPANDS these compact definitions into synthetic files in the real CP2 layouts (calendar files with explicit date lists, an ECB-layout EUR quote file, one RAW price file per listing), registers them with upstream 'synthetic' and synthetic: true, ingests them through the real parsers into one release M, and binds the port to M (tech plan §16.8 item 1). The expansion is mechanical: it introduces no number that is not in this block. Prices and rates are decimal strings exactly as given (no float, no re-rounding).

A market on holiday is not stale: HKEX closed 2025-01-29..31, the 2025-01-28 close is CURRENT (0 missed), AVAILABLE with no STALE_DATA (market-data Ruling 5.2).
Split neutrality: on the ex-date the ledger quantity is 200 and the RAW close is 37.50, so the AAPL value is 7,500, exactly as before; the total equals P1-V3's.
A Sunday: closes of 2025-03-07 and the 2025-03-07 fixing. Presented parts and total.
The external in-kind transfer E8 (MSFT 10, no basis) is valued at the close of its date; valuation does not need a cost basis (PRD §9.3).
Period-B FX (16/125 USD per HKD terminates). Native per-currency subtotals (Ruling 1.4).
Negative account cash (A3, after INTEREST_CHARGED) is valued signed.
End of the active period.
A Saturday a year later: closes of 2026-01-30, fixing of 2026-01-30.

Since-inception TWR and G. Flows: E1 10,000 USD (01-02, BOD), E3 20,000 HKD (01-06, BOD, at 5/39), E8 MSFT 10 in kind (03-10, EOD, 4,000), X5 1,000 (05-08, BOD), X9 5,000 (06-02, BOD). Internal transfers E6, X13/X14 and the reversed X15 are not flows.
Trailing 3 months with the end-of-month rule (06-30 -> 03-31). Not annualized (Y < 1).
A 1Y window that starts before inception is refused, not padded with empty days (Ruling 5.4).
A 1Y window with Y exactly 1 (end-of-month rule, Ruling 7.1): the annualized TWR equals the period TWR exactly.
Since inception over 395 days: Y = 12/12 + 30/365 = 79/73; the annualized TWR is irrational (certified or Decimal-50, Ruling 2.1), so it carries a tolerance.
Before the snapshot the total is NOT_RECONSTRUCTABLE, never 0.
At S: an opening position with unknown basis is still valued (PRD §9.3). Reporting currency = native: no FX.
After the sale (HKEX closed 07-01; 07-02 is a session).
TWR since S (base = S, labelled since S) and trailing 1 month (07-31 -> 06-30 by the end-of-month rule): the same window. No flows.
Windows starting before S are NOT_RECONSTRUCTABLE (Ruling 5.4).

structural_assertions.statement: Every result computed for this fixture is marked synthetic (market-data Ruling 4.8), and every manifest cites the convention set ids given in this file's 'convention_sets' (1.2-part1: no longer spelled out here, so a convention bump that changes no expected value needs only that field updated).

Identity I-2 (Ruling 11.1): for P1-R1, P1-R2, P2-R1, P3-R1, P4-R2 and P6-R1, the product of the daily factors over every calendar day of the window equals the segment product exactly (Fraction equality). The calculator's printed factors are the segment factors.
Identity I-3: for every gain_absolute above, G equals V_E - V_B - (cash inflows + in-kind inflows - outflows) exactly.

Ruling 1.4a: the priced_holdings_value metric feeds nothing (no total, TWR, gain_absolute, weight or denominator). Evidence (1.1-part1): a code scan showing no module that computes those reads the partial figure, PLUS a scratch-copy mutation that substitutes the partial figure for a suppressed end value and is caught by a named test (P3-R3 or P3-R4 would then show a number).

Metamorphic: inserting an internal cash transfer pair of 100 USD from A1 to A3 on 2025-05-20 into P1 changes no PORTFOLIO-LEVEL assertion of P1 (portfolio_value in either view, twr, gain_absolute, annualized_twr). Account-level cash_value and holding_value items may legitimately change and are not part of S-5.
Determinism: byte-identical canonical results across runs and PYTHONHASHSEED values, and with events shuffled within a day (ledger_seq unchanged).
